headline: Dems have an edge over GOP, poll finds. And, ICE looks into 'mobile detention centers'
context: An NPR poll shows that Democrats have an edge over Republicans going into the midterms, partially due to Trump. And, Immigration and Customs Enforcement is looking into "mobile detention centers."
